result.topic_en: Calculations on the equations of linear elasticity (with a parameter theta and a term m^2(u^2+v^2+w^2)): variation of an energy integral, boundary conditions, and exponential/trigonometric plane-wave solutions satisfying characteristic equations, with coefficient conditions at a boundary.

methods.what: Energy integral for elastic deformations including a mass/frequency term
Free-surface (stress-free) boundary conditions for elasticity at a plane z=const
methods.quote: $2\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}+2\theta\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\big)=0$

methods.what: Exponential (plane-wave) ansatz for displacements and dilatation potential
Characteristic (dispersion) equations for the two wave types
Transversality condition for the divergence-free part
Elimination of C via transversality, giving coefficient equations with cos/sin of pi c and gamma c
